items.title: Structure Flow
items.summary: ThreeUI Community 的三维场研究：结构流、轨道球、点阵、星云与流体场等免费变体。免登录，可在浏览页直接预览。
items.qualityNote: 适合当 Agent 的第一块三维 Hero：复制页面里的 prompt / Skill.md，只改色相、点大小和运动速度，不必手改 procedural JS。
items.promptHint: 用 Structure Flow 做产品首屏背景。保持免费 Community 变体，换成我们的主色，放慢速度，点更疏一点。
items.summaryEn: A ThreeUI Community 3D field study: free variants for structure flow, orbit orbs, lattices, nebulae, and fluid fields. No login; preview on the browse page.
items.qualityNoteEn: A good first 3D hero for an Agent: copy the page prompt / Skill.md and only change hue, point size, and speed — no hand-editing of procedural JS.
items.promptHintEn: Use Structure Flow as a product first-screen background. Keep the free Community variant, switch to our primary color, slow it down, and thin out the points.

items.title: Predictive Arc
items.summary: Canvas / WebGL 信号弧：预测弧、像素弧、粒子、网格与半调流动。免费变体都在 Community 目录里。
items.qualityNote: 仪表盘或「推理中」状态很好用。把 prompt 交给 Agent，调 hue / speed，做成自己的数据弧，不要去碰 Pro 变体。
items.promptHint: 把 Predictive Arc 嵌进控制台顶栏。用免费变体，改成品牌琥珀色，速度放慢，保持可读。
items.summaryEn: Canvas / WebGL signal arcs: predictive arc, pixel arc, particles, grid, and halftone flow. Free variants live in the Community directory.
items.qualityNoteEn: Works well for a dashboard or “thinking” state. Hand the prompt to an Agent, tune hue / speed, and make it your data arc — stay off Pro variants.
items.promptHintEn: Drop Predictive Arc into a console top bar. Use a free variant, switch to brand amber, slow it down, and keep it readable.

items.title: Brand Orbs
items.summary: 一组 Canvas 品牌球：Claude、Cursor、GitHub、Figma 等免费变体，适合做工具墙或集成列表。
items.qualityNote: 集成页图标墙的现成起点。Skill 侧只需换 logo 与尺寸，主题可整组一起改。
items.promptHint: 用 Brand Orbs 做「已接入工具」一排。只保留免费变体，尺寸统一，悬停轻轻转。
items.summaryEn: A set of Canvas brand orbs: free Claude, Cursor, GitHub, Figma, and other variants. Fits a tools wall or integrations list.
items.qualityNoteEn: A ready start for an integrations icon wall. On the Skill side, swap logos and size; the theme can change as a group.
items.promptHintEn: Use Brand Orbs as a “tools we connect” row. Keep free variants only, unify the size, and let hover spin gently.

items.title: Rectangle Buttons
items.summary: Community 矩形按钮族：暗玻璃、Launch、点边框、滑动文字、渐变光束等免费 CTA，纯 CSS/DOM。
items.qualityNote: 落地页主按钮最快可换的一套。复制 prompt，改主色和文案即可，Agent 不用重写动效。
items.promptHint: 从 Rectangle Buttons 挑一个免费 CTA。文案改成「开始试用」，主色换成站点强调色。
items.summaryEn: Community rectangle button family: dark glass, Launch, dotted borders, sliding type, gradient beams, and other free CTAs. Pure CSS/DOM.
items.qualityNoteEn: The fastest swap for a landing primary button. Copy the prompt, change color and copy; the Agent does not need to rewrite motion.
items.promptHintEn: Pick a free CTA from Rectangle Buttons. Change the copy to “Start trial” and the color to the site accent.

items.title: Shader Buttons
items.summary: 着色器按钮：Star Portal、Ignition、Plasma、Thinking 等免费 WebGL 变体，适合高能量 CTA。
items.qualityNote: 想让 Agent 做出「会呼吸」的按钮时用这组。Skill.md 里改色相就够，别手写 GLSL。
items.promptHint: 用 Shader Buttons 的免费 Thinking 变体做「生成中」按钮。换成靛紫色，亮度略降。
items.summaryEn: Shader buttons: free WebGL variants such as Star Portal, Ignition, Plasma, and Thinking. Fits a high-energy CTA.
items.qualityNoteEn: Use this set when you want an Agent to make a button that “breathes.” Changing hue in Skill.md is enough — do not hand-write GLSL.
items.promptHintEn: Use the free Thinking variant from Shader Buttons as a “generating” button. Switch to indigo and drop the brightness a little.

items.title: Constellation Field
items.summary: 粒子星座场：漂移、网络、关口流、连线与等高线等免费 Canvas 变体，适合做连接感背景。
items.qualityNote: 多 Agent / 网络叙事的背景。把 prompt 交给 Agent，调密度和描边，主题一换就走。
items.promptHint: 用 Constellation Field 做「协作网络」背景。粒子疏一点，线细一点，颜色跟纸色底和解。
items.summaryEn: Particle constellation fields: free Canvas variants for drift, networks, gate flow, links, and contours. Fits a connected-feeling background.
items.qualityNoteEn: A background for multi-agent / network stories. Hand the prompt to an Agent, tune density and stroke; once the theme changes, ship it.
items.promptHintEn: Use Constellation Field as a “collaboration network” background. Fewer particles, thinner lines, colors that sit with the paper base.

items.title: Landscape
items.summary: 可切换晨昏与天气的三维地貌：日出、正午、日落、夜晚、雨、雪等免费变体。
items.qualityNote: 氛围页或天气产品的现成场景。Agent 按 Skill 换时段即可，不必重建地形。
items.promptHint: 用 Landscape 的日落变体做封面。保持 Community 免费集，不要换成 Pro 地貌。
items.summaryEn: A 3D landscape that can switch time of day and weather: free sunrise, noon, sunset, night, rain, and snow variants.
items.qualityNoteEn: A ready scene for an atmosphere page or weather product. The Agent only needs to change the time of day per the Skill — no need to rebuild terrain.
items.promptHintEn: Use the Landscape sunset variant as a cover. Stay on the free Community set; do not switch to Pro terrain.

items.title: Sketchbook
items.summary: MengTo Sketchbook 落地页：像一本可翻的速写本，Community 整页可打开，免登录。
items.qualityNote: 作品集叙事的整页模板。把 prompt 交给 Agent，换封面字与纸色，结构先别拆。
items.promptHint: 以 Sketchbook 落地页为骨架，改成我们的作品集首页。保留翻页节奏，只换文案与主色。
items.summaryEn: MengTo Sketchbook landing: like a flip-through sketchbook. The full Community page opens with no login.
items.qualityNoteEn: A full-page template for portfolio narrative. Hand the prompt to an Agent, swap cover type and paper color, and leave the structure alone at first.
items.promptHintEn: Use the Sketchbook landing as the skeleton of our portfolio home. Keep the page-turn rhythm; only change copy and primary color.

items.title: Kage
items.summary: Kage 落地页：偏影与留白的整页模板，Community 免费，可调标题字体与主色。
items.qualityNote: 安静品牌站的好起点。Skill 控制字体与主色，Agent 换主题比重写布局更快。
items.promptHint: 用 Kage 做品牌介绍页。标题换成我们的中文名，主色用靛蓝，保持大留白。
items.summaryEn: Kage landing: a full-page template of shadow and leftover space. Community-free; title type and primary color can be tuned.
items.qualityNoteEn: A good start for a quiet brand site. The Skill controls type and primary color; an Agent rethemes faster than rewriting layout.
items.promptHintEn: Use Kage as a brand intro page. Change the title to our Chinese name, use indigo as the primary, and keep the large leftover space.

items.title: Complete Shelf
items.summary: 整面书架落地页：适合书店、课程目录或「全部作品」索引。Community 免费整页。
items.qualityNote: 目录型站点可直接复用。让 Agent 按 Skill 换书脊颜色与标题，不要重做货架几何。
items.promptHint: 用 Complete Shelf 做课程目录。每本书脊写一门课名，主色跟随站点纸色。
items.summaryEn: A full-wall bookshelf landing: fits a bookstore, course catalog, or “all work” index. Free Community full page.
items.qualityNoteEn: Catalog sites can reuse this as-is. Let the Agent change spine colors and titles per the Skill — do not rebuild the shelf geometry.
items.promptHintEn: Use Complete Shelf as a course catalog. Each spine is a course name; primary color follows the site paper tone.

items.title: Sylva · Living Green
items.summary: Sylva 落地页的免费 Living Green 变体：整页森林氛围。同系列 Sakura / Maple / Sequoia 是 Pro，本库不收录。
items.qualityNote: 自然向产品的免费整页。只链 Living Green； sakura / maple 等 Pro 变体不要打开、不要写进 prompt。
items.promptHint: 只用 Sylva 的 Living Green。改标题和主色，不要切换到标了 PRO 的季节变体。
items.summaryEn: The free Living Green variant of the Sylva landing: a full-page forest mood. Sakura / Maple / Sequoia in the same series are Pro and are not listed here.
items.qualityNoteEn: A free full page for nature-leaning products. Link Living Green only; do not open or prompt sakura / maple and other Pro variants.
items.promptHintEn: Use only Sylva’s Living Green. Change the title and primary color. Do not switch to seasonal variants marked PRO.

items.title: Text Path Studies
items.summary: 路径字研究：地球字、轮廓流动、字形云、布料、涟漪与球体等免费 Canvas 变体。
items.qualityNote: 章节标题想「会走路径」时用。Agent 改字与色相即可，几何交给现成 Skill。
items.promptHint: 用 Text Path Studies 做章节大标题。文字改成中文产品名，色相跟纸色底协调。
items.summaryEn: Path-type studies: free Canvas variants for globe type, outline flow, glyph clouds, cloth, ripples, and spheres.
items.qualityNoteEn: Use when a chapter title should “walk a path.” The Agent only changes the words and hue; geometry stays with the existing Skill.
items.promptHintEn: Use Text Path Studies for a chapter title. Change the words to the Chinese product name; hue should sit with the paper base.

items.title: Gallery Heading
items.summary: 画廊字标：斜向升起、坠落、横扫与循环等免费变体，适合作品集分节。
items.qualityNote: 分节标题的现成动效。复制 prompt 换字体与色相，Agent 不用重做扫光。
items.promptHint: 用 Gallery Heading 做作品集分节。标题换成「精选」，字体粗一点，色相偏靛。
items.summaryEn: Gallery wordmarks: free rising-diagonal, falling, sweep, and loop variants. Fits portfolio section breaks.
items.qualityNoteEn: Ready motion for section titles. Copy the prompt to change type and hue; the Agent does not need to rebuild the sweep.
items.promptHintEn: Use Gallery Heading for portfolio sections. Change the title to “Featured,” make the type a bit heavier, hue toward indigo.

items.title: Article Headings
items.summary: 文章开头字标：介绍字、粒子词标与音频词标等免费变体，适合长文或更新日志顶栏。
items.qualityNote: 博客/日志标题可复用。把 Skill 交给 Agent 换文案和节奏，粒子密度别开太高。
items.promptHint: 用 Article Headings 做更新日志顶栏。文字改成「今日收录」，粒子少一点，方便阅读。
items.summaryEn: Article-open wordmarks: free intro type, particle wordmarks, and audio wordmarks. Fits a long-form or changelog header.
items.qualityNoteEn: Reusable for blog/log titles. Hand the Skill to an Agent to change copy and rhythm; keep particle density low.
items.promptHintEn: Use Article Headings as a changelog header. Change the words to “Listed today,” fewer particles, easier to read.

items.title: Koi Studies
items.summary: ThreeUI Community 的锦鲤卡片叠：CSS 3D 深度、指针倾斜、拖拽/键盘翻页，三张日本画风研究（Kōhaku / Shūsui / Utsuri）。免登录，可复制 prompt。
items.summaryEn: ThreeUI Community koi card stack: CSS 3D depth, pointer tilt, drag and keyboard paging, three Japanese studies (Kōhaku / Shūsui / Utsuri). No login; copy the prompt.
items.qualityNote: Community 免费组件，出现在 ThreeUI 公开「最新」列表。复制 Skill.md 只改纸色、印章红和翻页速度即可，不必手写 CSS 3D。
items.qualityNoteEn: A free Community component on ThreeUI’s public Newest list. Copy Skill.md and only change paper color, seal red, and flip speed — no hand-written CSS 3D.
items.promptHint: 用 Koi Studies 做作品集封面。保持 Community 免费变体，换成我们的纸色和主红，翻页慢一点，打开减弱动效时用静态叠。
items.promptHintEn: Use Koi Studies as a portfolio cover. Keep the free Community variant, switch to our paper color and primary red, slow the flip, and use a static stack when reduced motion is on.

items.title: Bestsellers Book Showcase
items.summary: ThreeUI Community 的完整 Field Manuals 书封陈列落地页：编辑式排版、作者动效、嵌入媒体，可改标题字体与主色。免登录。
items.summaryEn: ThreeUI Community’s complete Field Manuals book-cover showcase landing page: editorial layout, authored motion, embedded media, with heading font and primary color controls. No login.
items.qualityNote: Community 免费完整 HTML 落地页，不是 Pro。适合让 Agent 当「书/系列产品首屏」模板，只改字体和主色。
items.qualityNoteEn: A free Community full-HTML landing page, not Pro. A good Agent template for a book/series first screen: change font and primary color only.
items.promptHint: 用 Bestsellers Book Showcase 做系列手册首屏。保持 Community 免费版，换成我们的书名、主色和衬线字体，不要加 Pro 变体。
items.promptHintEn: Use Bestsellers Book Showcase as a series-manual first screen. Keep the free Community edition, swap in our titles, primary color, and serif; do not add Pro variants.

items.title: Country Towers
items.summary: ThreeUI Community 的六国塔楼场景：日式天守、中式、越南、泰国、高棉、奥斯曼，程序化地形上自动搭建，可轨道旋转。免登录。
items.summaryEn: ThreeUI Community six-country tower scene: Japanese tenshu, Chinese, Vietnamese, Thai, Khmer, and Ottoman, assembling on a procedural landscape with orbit controls. No login.
items.qualityNote: Community 免费 Three.js 场景，六个国家变体都在免费目录里。适合当地理/建筑向 Hero，不要写成 Pro。
items.qualityNoteEn: A free Community Three.js scene; all six country variants are in the free catalog. A good geography/architecture hero. Do not describe it as Pro.
items.promptHint: 用 Country Towers 的 Japan 变体做文化产品首屏。保持 Community 免费版，相机再远一点，搭建动画放慢，地形再绿一些。
items.promptHintEn: Use the Japan variant of Country Towers as a cultural-product first screen. Keep the free Community edition, pull the camera back, slow the build animation, and make the terrain a bit greener.

items.title: Character Carousel
items.summary: ThreeUI Community 的角色卡片走马灯：浅色胶片带与深色波浪两种免费变体，指针/滚轮/键盘切换人像卡片。适合 Agent 团队墙。免登录。
items.summaryEn: ThreeUI Community character-card carousel: a light filmstrip and a dark wave as free variants, with pointer, wheel, and keyboard switching. A good Agent team wall. No login.
items.qualityNote: Community 免费 UI 件，和已有 Brand Orbs 不同：这是人像卡片而不是 logo 球。复制 prompt 换名字、职位和配色即可。
items.qualityNoteEn: A free Community UI piece, distinct from Brand Orbs: portrait cards, not logo orbs. Copy the prompt and swap names, titles, and palette.
items.promptHint: 用 Character Carousel 的 filmstrip 变体做 Agent 团队墙。保持 Community 免费版，换成我们的人名与职责，主色跟品牌走。
items.promptHintEn: Use the filmstrip variant of Character Carousel as an Agent team wall. Keep the free Community edition, swap in our names and roles, and match the brand color.
